title: Hackers reportedly breached an open-source intelligence platform used by US agencies, relayed from the New York Times
date_note: The relaying pages give only the day of the New York Times report, 24 November.
geo_basis: United States, where the agencies are based
summary: RBC Ukraine, citing the New York Times, says an open-source intelligence platform used by the CIA, ODNI and NGA may have been hit; agencies state secret networks were not harmed and it is fixed. RBC says early signs point to China, but attackers are not identified. Tin Tuc and VTC News name the AI tool Artex. TSN adds the ODNI said critical systems were not disrupted.
plain: RBC Ukraine, citing the New York Times, says a US intelligence open-source analysis platform may have been breached. Officials say secret networks were not affected and it is fixed.
exec: Per the New York Times as relayed by RBC Ukraine, a platform used by US intelligence agencies may have been breached; officials say secret networks were unaffected.

sources.name: RBC Ukraine (relaying the New York Times)
Tin Tuc (Vietnam), relaying the New York Times via RT
VTC News (via baomoi.com), relaying the New York Times
TSN (Ukraine), relaying the New York Times

validation.note: Two Ukrainian publishers read (RBC Ukraine, 112 Ukraine), both relaying the New York Times / Bloomberg reporting, which was not read (the NYT page was not found; searches returned nothing). No US agency statement was read. Tin Tuc and VTC News (read 26 Nov) also relay the Times and say the agencies had not commented; still one original report. TSN (read 26 Nov) also relays the Times; still one original report. PNN (read 27 Nov) relays CNN, which according to PNN cites unnamed sources saying the breach hit a system for analysing open-source intelligence at the CIA and ODNI and did not reach classified information; the CNN page itself was not read, so the record stays single_source.

review.note: Compared agencies, secret networks unaffected, China sign, ODNI statement, Artex against RBC, TSN, Tin Tuc; single_source and developing right
